name: GET /api/voice-agent/presets - List voice agent preset stacks
description: Returns the generally-available BYOK preset stacks a tenant clones into a stack profile: budget, balanced and premium (covers deef80bf-b0ce-4295-9cf0-878c4f5bfd02#AC2 — GET /api/voice-agent/presets returns the Budget, Balanced and Premium presets). Each preset names a provider+model per layer (telephony, stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts), the layers a stack profile needs credentials for, and an indicative provider cost per call-minute. Static catalogue data — no tenant rows are read, but the route still requires a tenant JWT like every voice-agent route. Each preset also carries layer_certification — {layer, catalog_key, certification_status, certified} for stt, llm_fast, llm_complex and tts, read live from the speech catalog — and available, true only when every one of those entries is certified (322b0d69-8fde-47e0-aaf7-8c6420ed492b#AC3 — uncertified entries are flagged and cannot be used in a preset). A preset whose entry an operator revokes turns available=false at once; creating a stack profile from it is then refused with 422 UncertifiedProvider.
